referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Includes the whole manufacturing process to produce organic cover coat (raw material provision, raw material mixing, packing, and storage), transports to plant, and infrastructure. No requirements for administration are included. No additional buildings and land-use have been taken into account as it is assumed that the mixing process takes place in an existing building of the sand/cement industry or on the construction site

geography.text: The amount of raw materials is based on estimations. The transportation distance is an estimation. For the infrastructure, acrylic binder and white spirit RER-, for the additives DE- and for the organic chemicals GLO-modules are used as proxy

technology.text: Assumed average current technology. The raw materials are mixed in a certain ratio, transported to the packing installation and packed.
